summary: Student-led business idea challenge (no prototype needed in the Idea Category). Submit an application and an English pitch video of up to five minutes.
eligibility: 3–6 undergraduate or postgraduate students from universities in Japan or abroad; cross-university and international-only teams allowed. Student-led, not faculty research; correspondence programmes excluded.
title: Tokyo Global Innovation Challenge 2026
deadlineLabel: Application deadline (time and timezone not specified)
notes: At least the finalist presenters must attend in Tokyo on 19–20 December at their own expense. AI-generated voice narration is prohibited.
